name: Noelle Desktop Agent
description: Local AI model lab for macOS, Windows and Linux. Hardware advisor, local model execution (GGUF, MLX, EXL2, Transformers), evaluation lab, knowledge canvas RAG, local OpenAI-compatible API, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) server.

skills.name: Hardware & VRAM Compatibility Advisor
skills.description: Analyze system accelerator, usable RAM/VRAM, bandwidth, and determine model fit and quantization tiers.

skills.name: Local Model Execution & Management
skills.description: Discover, run, and manage open models (GGUF, MLX, EXL2, Transformers) completely on-device without telemetry.

skills.name: Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server
skills.description: Provide MCP tools for Claude Code, Cursor, and agents to interact with local models and knowledge bases.

skills.name: Knowledge Canvas & Local RAG
skills.description: Chunk, embed, and query local documents and notes with full vector search on your machine.

skills.name: Model Evaluation Lab
skills.description: Benchmark and compare prompt outputs, latency, memory consumption, and tokens per second side-by-side.

tools.name: get_noelle_info
tools.description: Get general overview, architecture, and capabilities of Noelle local AI lab.

tools.name: get_hardware_advisor
tools.description: Get guidance on memory requirements and model quant recommendations based on VRAM.

tools.name: get_mcp_config
tools.description: Get configuration snippet for Claude Code, Cursor, or Claude Desktop to connect to Noelle's MCP server.

tools.name: get_api_docs
tools.description: Get information about the local OpenAI-compatible API endpoints (http://127.0.0.1:8765/v1).

tools.name: get_download_info
tools.description: Get download links and platform support for macOS, Windows, and Linux.
